facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya issued Circular No. 18 (dated 1 June 2025 in this write-up) whose data protection regulation states it is prohibited to store personal, financial, credit or sensitive data outside Libya, binding on banks, foreign bank branches, fintechs, payment providers, exchange and leasing companies from 1 July 2026; the document is an undated workshop write-up, published 2025-01-01 as a year-only placeholder.
facts.system: CBL Circular No. 18 data protection system and executive regulation

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya, which issued the regulation, supervises the covered entities, sets a fine of 100,000 LYD per violation, may revoke licences for repeated gross violations, and requires each institution to appoint a Libyan Data Officer as its liaison.
